thread:
kai: Drafting a small experiment for Embeddings preview: add export presets (CSV / JSONL), column visibility, and a compact density toggle. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/embed-presets
ellie: Presets look useful. Can we show a truncated header preview so folks see columns (e.g., id, text, vector_1536)?
devin: A11y: preset dropdown needs aria-expanded/aria-controls and arrow-key navigation. Announce "Preset X applied" in a live region.
sasha: Copy tweak: label presets as actions, e.g., "Download: CSV (basic)" to make intent clear.
kai: Good call. Also adding a tooltip when "include vectors" is on: "Including vectors increases file size. Estimated size: ~N MB."
ellie: Contrast nit: compact density uses 11px meta text. Fail at 4.5:1. Bump to 12px or increase contrast. Ensure 44px touch targets on mobile.
devin: Column resize should not be mouse-only. Support arrow-key nudges when header focused and announce width changes. Use role=slider pattern.
aria-bot: Selection live region reminder: announce "N items selected" and ensure selection toolbar follows table in the DOM for predictable focus.
sasha: UX: default sort in inspector should be relevance (not recent). Add helper text: "Sorted by relevance" so it's discoverable.
kai: Added a quick mapping review modal in Figma with 3-row preview and "Apply mapping to all exports" checkbox. Will prototype keyboard flow. PTAL by EOD.
